title: DIY: EASY MACRAME KEYCHAIN TUTORIAL | MACRAME SEASHELL KEYRING | STEP BY STEP
description:
Hi guys, thanks for stopping by my channel! In today's tutorial we are making this beautiful  macrame seashell keychain. I also have a seashell tutorial for a wall decal as well, I will link it below incase you want to give it a try. 

SEASHELL TUTORIAL:   https://youtu.be/IODKNnEw3ug

 If you are new to macrame, or need extra help with the Diagonal clove hitch knot, also called double hitch knots, please watch this video before you begin. It is a slow, step by step video on exactly how to make them, and I have included all of my tips and tricks to help as  well:

https://youtu.be/kv0ejZeVoWY

MEASUREMENTS:
LENGTH: 6.5in/17cm
WIDTH: 1.75in/5cm

HERE IS WHAT I USED: 
- 1.25in/3cm swivel clasp in gold from Amazon, I DO NOT HAVE A LINK!
- 3mm string in natural cut to: 
   4 x 30in/76cm
   1 x 10in/25cm 


HERE IS A LINK TO THE EXACT CORD I USED:

https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/932264038/premium-3mm-macrame-cord-single-twist?ref=shop_home_recs_16&pro=1&frs=1

 For more macrame and inspiration, find me on Instagram @soulful__notions (2 underscores)
